title: Non functional and shady pricing practices
body:
I don’t normally leave reviews but I found this app so infuriating I thought I would share my experience.

I paid NZD$3.99 for the trial. I’ve tried using this app several times over the years  because I love the concept. This time however the app crashed each time I tried to tap on the first journey. I tried multiple times to restart and redownload the app but I wouldn’t expect this - I am using an iPhone 15 with the latest iOS.

When I reached out to describe my issue and request a refund the support team advised me the trial is non-refundable. My fault for not reading the ts and cs correctly, sure, but also annoying was the 250 character limit on my description of the issue, which only popped up after I had written out a detailed explanation of where I was experiencing the app crashing, which I thought would be helpful to the developers. Also no acknowledgment from the team that the app is faulty.

So now fabulous has my money and I have nothing - would not recommend this app to anyone.

body:

Six months on I have had half a dozen attempts from them to charge my card (with no $$ in the account) and upon going back through billing see this is the third time they’ve charged me for an app I absolutely cancelled in the app during the free trial.

I proceeded to cancel AGAIN via their online dashboard - successfully - only for them to charge my card two days later even though the membership has been cancelled twice before.

Contacting customer service, I only asked for the most recent charge to be refunded not the two prior - despite them being fraudulent charges - and their team are refusing. I cannot stand companies that go out of their way to make it hard to cancel; don’t follow it through; and don’t refund when they have blatantly breached the conditions of holding your CC number. It is theft.

title: Beware
body:
So I signed up for the trial it didn’t give me one but instead charged me $68.00NZD. 
I like the aesthetic somewhat but there are ads built into the app not exactly the same as other ads in apps where it forces you to watch them for so many seconds, it’s a static add posing as a post or a more information, so for example they will promote Elixer and tell you about it but it’s another app to purchase which I assume at the same price. 
I hate the red notifications along the bottom, they are again for more ads why did I pay premium if I keep having these ads.
The only motivation to use the app is because I wasted money on it, and I haven’t used it for two weeks. I find the notifications annoying they aren’t related to my habits but rather them promoting mindfulness or something along those lines but again very boring. Feels empty, no value in information they share. 
The timer is weird so you can give a habit 2mins to complete right, so gives you a time then you tick when finished and it goes straight into the next habit so shower timer then straight into breakfast?! That doesn’t make sense. You can’t pause you just exit the timer and then have to go back in. Gosh. The more I think about this app the more annoyed I get so. There are genuine things I don’t like about this app but not articulated well and I’ve wasted enough time related to this app.

I am day 5 of using the app and 3 days into intermittent fasting and I actually think this is the app that I needed. It hits just the right amount and seems to say all the right things to ensure I stay on track. I wish my will was strong enough to do it all on my own but solo working parent... getting stuff done takes all my energy and after WAY TO MANY years of giving others my energy and commitment i think this is the app that will push me to do so. 

Try it. The free version is a great intro and doesn’t cut you at the knees. It’s inevitable that I purchase the full version... the next 30 days are going to happen regardless... take the chance.

title: Not for me
body:
The app is beautiful, both design and sound and engaging. However I found that it was fill with BS.

First, I selected I wanted to use it to increase productivity and motivation. It started me on the default journey about drinking water every morning, because it is better than soda (duh!). Maybe ask first if I need to break an habit of drinking soda before asking me to drink water! Then offer me something more meaningful regarding the goals you asked me to set!

Second, the subscription model is very shady. The app only gives you 7 days of free trial and then it is asking for one full year up front. One week is too short to assess if an habit will work or not so the you need to pay for a full year before knowing if the app is doing the job or not. Beside, the fact that the two options are either to pay one full year or a lifetime (equivalent to 6+ full years) made me think the app is definitely not working. If it was, there would be an option to pay monthly as they would be confident users will stick around. Right now, I believe they are banking on people paying one full year without caring much if they use the app or not.

body:

The only thing that bugs me (and why it’s not a 5 star for me) is that the app creators use premium membership subscription as an incentive for doing well in your routines. Eg “oh wow, good work you’ve unlocked an awesome offer, get premium for $xx a year, this is really rare!”. It makes me not want to upgrade because what are they going to incentivise with if I was a premium member? I feel like they should keep the two things seperate.

title: It’s looks good but not user friendly
body:
It has been 3 months and I find it very difficult to use. There are routines and some set habits which are easy to add but there is no flexibility in choosing days. For instance all habits has to be done 7 days a week. I can only choose time not days. Also, if you forget to tick routine it will not let you tick off next day. 
It is visually appealing app but certainly not user friendly.

author: Ank1009

title: 5 Stars: Helpful and Available
body:
Highly satisfied with this app. Thank you so much! :)

- Super helpful, does exactly what it says it does in its description and more. Challenges are easy at first and gradually accumulate, but by then it won’t be a huge struggle.
- So many journeys and resources available, for free. It’s so rare to find these nowadays - quality apps that give you what they advertise, without having to pay just to get more than a teaser. You don’t even need an account.
- No ads! Like the above, this is so rare nowadays. I really appreciate not having distracting ads when the goal of the app is just the opposite. It shows that the devs have really thought it through and aren’t just in it for the money.

So grateful for ‘Fabulous’ - and respect for the developers.

If you are reading this review, definitely give this app a try. :)
